note: RA in decimal hours, Dec in decimal degrees. magnitude is approximate visual. Solar-system bodies have computeAtRuntime=true; the app calculates their positions.

subgalleries.name: Full Moon
subgalleries.description: Brightest phase. Fully illuminated disk.

subgalleries.name: New Moon
subgalleries.description: Dark Moon. Earthshine and faint glow only.

subgalleries.name: Crescent
subgalleries.description: Thin sliver, waxing or waning.

subgalleries.name: First Quarter
subgalleries.description: Half-lit disk, waxing.

subgalleries.name: Last Quarter
subgalleries.description: Half-lit disk, waning.

subgalleries.name: Gibbous
subgalleries.description: Between quarter and full, waxing or waning.

subgalleries.name: Blood Moon
subgalleries.description: Total lunar eclipse — reddish from refracted sunlight.

subgalleries.name: Supermoon
subgalleries.description: Full Moon near perigee. ~14% larger than average.

subgalleries.name: Blue Moon
subgalleries.description: Second full Moon in a calendar month (or third of four in a season).

subgalleries.name: Harvest / Hunter Moon
subgalleries.description: Full Moon nearest autumnal equinox (Harvest) or following (Hunter).

subgalleries.name: Earthshine
subgalleries.description: Faint sunlight reflected off Earth, illuminating the dark side.

subgalleries.name: Daytime
subgalleries.description: Moon visible during the day.

subgalleries.name: Occultation
subgalleries.description: Moon passing in front of a planet or bright star.

subgalleries.name: White light
subgalleries.description: Standard solar filter view. Photosphere and sunspots.

subgalleries.name: Sunspot close-up
subgalleries.description: Zoomed on active regions — umbra, penumbra, granulation.

subgalleries.name: Hydrogen-alpha
subgalleries.description: 656 nm narrowband. Prominences, filaments, chromosphere.

subgalleries.name: Partial eclipse
subgalleries.description: Moon partially covering the Sun's disc.

subgalleries.name: Total eclipse
subgalleries.description: Corona visible during totality.

subgalleries.name: Annular eclipse
subgalleries.description: Ring of fire — Moon inside the solar disc but too small to cover it.

subgalleries.name: Transit
subgalleries.description: Mercury or Venus crossing the solar disc.

subgalleries.name: Sunrise / Sunset
subgalleries.description: Horizon shot. Atmospheric reddening, green flash.
